title: Clancy meeting 2

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Well there you are. Look at you. Ready to hit the big-time. Gotta respect that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well there you are. Look at you. Ready to hit the big-time. Gotta respect that.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Eager. As we always say here, early bird catches the good leads.

nodes.text: That was it... the early bird thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was it... the early bird thing.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Well that's what we do here! I assume I can sign you up for the next lesson?

nodes.text: Now now now, no need for the big talk. It's all there in the terms and conditions.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: You didn't ask! I mean if this has left you wanting more, I can get you signed up to the next package?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You didn't ask! I mean if this has left you wanting more, I can get you signed up to the next package?

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: One hundred Lims plus a ten Lim admin fee.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One hundred Lims plus a ten Lim admin fee.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: I'll be honest, people don't normally drop out of the course this early. Really is a sign of weakness. But if you're sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be honest, people don't normally drop out of the course this early. Really is a sign of weakness. But if you're sure?

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: Such an honor to be riding with you on this journey! Meet me again tomorrow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Such an honor to be riding with you on this journey! Meet me again tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Clancy Pantermino
nodes.text: How about this. We do another little taster free of charge?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about this. We do another little taster free of charge?
